display.purpose: Page titles and the signature navy hero only.

body.purpose: All reading copy; cap measure at 65 to 75 characters.

label.purpose: Structural mono uppercase kickers, used sparingly.

data.purpose: Tabular mono figures for money, counts, times, IDs.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Subtle separation for cards on canvas.

motion.name: ease-out-quart

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view. Command Navy fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1a4d8f; color: #fff; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #133766; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a4d8f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #cbd5e1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a4d8f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Text field with label above, navy focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #334155; } .ds-input { background: #ffffff; color: #0f172a; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 9px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #94a3b8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1a4d8f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(26,77,143,0.25); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Tone-based status with leading dot; meaning never rides on color alone.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background: #d6f0e3; color: #0c3120; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1f7a4d; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar rail item; active uses navy text, mist background, left accent bar.
components.html: Home
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; color: #64748b; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 9px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #f1f5f9; color: #0f172a; } .ds-nav-active { color: #1a4d8f; background: #e8f0fa; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 3px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #1a4d8f; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Single metric: mono label, tabular value, optional delta.
components.html: NEW LEADS128+12% vs last week
components.css: .ds-stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 14px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,26,35,0.06), 0 1px 1px rgba(20,26,35,0.04); } .ds-stat-label { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.656rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #64748b; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #0f172a; } .ds-stat-delta { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: #1f7a4d; }

narrative.overview: A premium control room for running a business. The operator sits down and the one number that matters is already looking back at them. It fuses Linear's precision with the breathing room of Notion and Height, reading as expensive without feeling cold. Depth and polish come from precision and space, not decoration. The product handles clients' leads and money, so every surface should feel handled and reliable.
keyCharacteristics: Calm surfaces, one obvious focal point per screen
Quiet navy authority with a strictly rationed accent
Effortless reading: text is always easy to find and re-find
Depth through space and weight, not effects
One system expressed three ways (client desktop baseline, admin tower, mobile)

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Command Navy covers at most 10 percent of any screen. One primary action per view in navy; everything else is neutral.

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Gold means money and nothing else. If a value is not currency, it is never gold.

rules.name: The No-Wash Rule
rules.body: The brand color is an accent, never a background fill for large areas beyond the single signature hero.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change uses tabular figures so columns never shift.

rules.name: The Layer-First Rule
rules.body: Reach for a tonal surface step before reaching for a shadow. Shadows are for things that actually float.

dos: Do give every screen one obvious focal point; when in doubt, remove, group, or add space.
Do keep Command Navy to roughly 10 percent of a screen and one primary action per view.
Do build depth with tonal surface steps and space first, shadows second.
Do use tabular mono figures for all money, counts, times, and IDs.
Do pair every status color with a dot, icon, or label so meaning never rides on color alone.
Do keep body text at AA (4.5:1), placeholder and helper text included, in both light and dark.
donts: Don't make it cluttered or busy. If a screen feels packed, it has failed even if it looks polished.
Don't look like GoHighLevel or a generic agency CRM.
Don't ship template-SaaS cliches: default purple gradients, identical card grids, the AI-made-this dashboard.
Don't fall into sterile gray-on-gray enterprise. Premium, never dull.
Don't wash large areas in the brand navy or use gold for anything that is not money.
Don't put a mono uppercase label above every section, and never nest a card inside a card.
